feeds.title: K1 Speed
feeds.description: Our blog shares the latest karting news, track info, instructive articles, info regarding our upcoming karting events, and more. K1 Speed has grown to become the premier indoor go-kart racing company worldwide since 2003. Offers highly-advanced and environmentally-friendly electric go-karts as well as authentic racing memorabilia, a Paddock Lounge café, private meeting rooms, and game areas. It is an upscale family entertainment center to visit or host a corporate event or party.

feeds.title: Kart Sport News

feeds.title: Karting Australia News
feeds.description: This website shares the latest news on Karting in Australia. The Australian Karting Association Ltd trading as Karting Australia is the governing body for the sport of Karting in Australia. Formed in 1966 the AKA has produced some of Australia's finest motor racing talents. Karting Australia is the sole body in Australia recognized by the Federation Internationale de 'l Automobile (FIA) and Motorsport Australia to organize and control the sport of Karting in Australia.
